verdict.rationale: Execution-time and CPU limits are a fair question for a compute platform like Fly.io, which runs Machines and Sprites for agent workloads. However, the evidence pack documents no CPU-time or wall-clock limits. The Sprite and Machine material covers isolation, checkpoints, sleep/wake behavior, disk size and restart policy, but none of it states execution-duration or CPU limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
